answer.reason: Two verses tell something that happened at or to the sea: the kings joined there in Genesis, and the Jordan's waters were cut off from it at Israel's crossing; the other verses are borders or visions.

clauses.english: was where the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah and their allies joined together
clauses.quote: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

clauses.english: had the Jordan's waters cut off from it as Israel crossed over on dry ground
clauses.quote: toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off

doubts: EZK 47:8-10 speaks of waters healing 'the sea' in a vision without naming the salt sea, so it was left out.
The border verses (NUM 34, DEU 3-4, JOS 12, 15, 18), 2KI 14:25 and the other marked verses only give boundaries or use 'the sea' without clearly meaning this one, so they were not used.
